@colibri/core.reason: Add spec-aware events, native Spec and Result exports, and supported lightweight errors/StrKey entrypoints. Reduce unnecessary registry and namespace initialization. Preserve spec error names/categories in extracted maps and surfaced matches. Add a contract-bound getLedgerEntry convenience method. Adopt ContractErrorMap as the primary error-map type name. Add validated Soroban values and spec-driven codecs with a granular values entrypoint. Add an explicit LocalSigner.fromKeypair convenience.
@colibri/core.apiReview: Additive event extraction, strict decoding and indexed filters. Preserve existing read/invoke pipelines and constructor plugin lifecycle. No additional mutable contract-error installer. Spec is the exact native SDK constructor and Result the native type; no wrappers. Granular imports share root implementations. Literal registry keys preserve stable codes; decorators, memoization and standards are unchanged. Error name/category fields are optional for existing manual maps and matches; spec/Wasm extraction populates them, and matching strategies and message behavior remain unchanged. Contract.getLedgerEntry accepts the existing key/durability shape without contractId, supplies the current bound ID and RPC, and preserves LedgerEntries.contractData defaults/results/errors. No new storage schema or codec inference; generated subclasses inherit it. ContractErrorMap replaces KnownContractErrorMap in signatures; the published old name remains a deprecated, structurally identical alias for current-major compatibility. No error matching or extraction behavior changes. Optional validated inputs for spec read/invoke/deploy, event filters and ledger keys; existing raw argument paths and plain/native Result outputs are retained. Native raw-call method signatures remain unchanged for extension compatibility; explicit toScVal adapts new values there. Full spec coverage, recursive custom types, ScError/Result codec extensions and lossless system ScVals are new APIs. Wrapped maps enforce canonical host key order. Native Spec remains the identical upstream constructor. SorobanType is a static public namespace with primitive aliases/codecs, Input types and Custom schema declarations. The values entrypoint additionally exports these members directly for tree-shakable namespace imports; Deno retains forwarded named namespaces, which is documented and measured separately. Pure annotations cover only reads of owned readonly static fields. Optional type metadata derives nested validated inputs while ordinary values remain assignable and decoded outputs stay plain. Tagged enums and numeric enums use spec-bound factories; explicit numeric codes are preserved and only map keys are sorted. SorobanCodec names the new codec class. These refinements replace only unpublished value APIs from this branch; all released 1.0 entrypoints and extension contracts are retained. Protected @internal decodeInvocationResult centralizes post-success decoding for typed subclasses. Existing invoke/invokeRaw signatures and execution remain unchanged. New CONTR_021 preserves the original successful result, method and unknown cause without changing existing ContractError metadata types. Organize the internal Soroban implementation into documented values, codecs and types pillars under soroban-types, with contract argument/result integration under contract/encoding. This is a behavior-preserving source reorganization: all public exports, the supported /values entrypoint, constructor identities and validation/encoding behavior remain unchanged. LocalSigner.fromKeypair borrows a native SDK signing keypair without extracting its secret. It returns the existing LocalSigner with only its own G-address as the default target. Destroying the adapter invalidates that signer without zeroizing the caller-owned keypair. Existing factories keep their owned-key cleanup and all Signer, TransactionConfig, process, pipeline and plugin contracts remain unchanged. New SIG_LOC_007 and SIG_LOC_008 report public-only and failed keypair adaptation; supplied keypairs are not stored in error metadata. Existing dependent plugins remain compatible and need no release. Export the existing LocalSigner error family as LocalSignerErrors, including the two additive adaptation codes; previous errors retain their identities and behavior. New event filters validate encoded indexed fields against the same ABI rules as decoding, rejecting M-addresses for Address while preserving G/C/M support for MuxedAddress. This refines the unpublished spec-aware event surface; existing released event APIs and package minimums are unchanged.

@colibri/contract-bindings.reason: Initial preview of portable typed bindings generation and a Deno CLI with JSR and npm package presets.
@colibri/contract-bindings.apiReview: New preview package. Emits constants.ts, types.ts and index.ts with spec-derived PascalCase names, named method inputs/outputs, typed generic read/invoke, errors and events using Core 1.1. Adds a contract-specific Markdown guide; no mutability inference. CLI choices use arrow-key menus; optional select callback preserves prompt-only adapters. Class-name prompts are removed in favor of filename defaults or ContractClient for remote sources. Provenance output is opt-in in CLI and programmatic generation. Generated clients import Spec and Result from Core, with no direct Stellar SDK package dependency. ContractMethods is a string enum with PascalCase members and exact ABI values; literal call names remain supported. Error metadata replaces duplicate runtime error enums; actual ABI references retain type-only numeric aliases. Generated types are grouped into methods, contract declarations, events and client configuration; generated imports use ContractErrorMap. Constants retain their layout. Generated declarations use SorobanType without Native suffixes. Custom schemas describe structs, positional structs and tagged or u32 enums; SorobanType.Input.Custom derives accepted inputs without duplicating fields. Same-name spec-bound factories validate all custom kinds, numeric members preserve explicit codes and error-code aliases reuse the categorized error map. Error definitions are not duplicated. Custom factory arguments use NameArgs, while method inputs retain MethodInput. Collisions with declared contract types use NameValueArgs. This renames only generated aliases in the unpublished preview; Core helpers and runtime representations are unchanged. New code requires the already planned Core 1.1 minimum. Generated invoke delegates decoding to the protected Core helper; duplicated runtime decode/error code is removed. The unpublished CBG_006 runtime code moves to Core CONTR_021; generator and CLI failures retain CBG_001 through CBG_005. CLI validates source identifiers, paths, network URLs and naming before advancing or loading a source. Invalid interactive answers remain editable; explicit invalid flags fail. CliIO.prompt gains an optional validation callback, while existing two-argument adapters continue to work with retry enforcement. Shared renderer naming rules preserve the portable boundary. Generated clients additionally expose a typed property for each callable ABI method with read(args) and invoke({ methodArgs, config, auth }) helpers, preserving the generic invoke object with only method omitted; zero-input methods use read() and can omit methodArgs from invoke({ config, auth }). Helpers delegate through the existing generic methods, retain their client when detached, and preserve authorization, result metadata and protected decoding. Convenience properties use camelCase while generic method keys and ABI dispatch retain exact spec spelling. Names colliding after normalization or with client members or object hooks receive a deterministic Method suffix documented in generation warnings and the guide; ordinary casing changes do not warn. The deployment-only __constructor is excluded from client helpers, ContractMethods and callable method maps; its complete spec entry and ConstructorInput remain available for deployment encoding. These generated-surface changes affect only the unpublished bindings preview. Existing generic read/invoke calls remain supported. This adds generated types and conveniences without changing the generator public API, Core execution or the planned package versions. Emit colibri.ts with selected original Core runtime helpers and public configuration/signer types. Root convenience reexports omit collisions with generated declarations; ABI names are preserved, and the dedicated module always exposes the helpers. New JSR/npm scaffolds export /colibri. Existing handwritten manifests remain preserved and need that subpath added manually if desired. Share template-reserved class names across generator validation and CLI defaults. Reject TypeScript type keywords and shadowed generated imports/globals before loading a source, while preserving valid independent names such as Omit. Unusable local filename defaults still fall back to ContractClient.

@colibri/identicon.reason: Add an SVG-only public renderer and subpath sharing the existing implementation, without PNG encoding dependencies.
@colibri/identicon.apiReview: Existing Identicon methods and output remain unchanged. The new identiconSvg function uses identical validation and rendering. Core error identity is shared through its supported errors subpath.
